Text.body:
Type what you want in plain words and press Return:
aapl                          the overview
aapl 5y                       chart over a range: 1d 5d 1m 3m 6m ytd 1y 2y 5y 10y max
aapl filings                  or news, financials, balance sheet, earnings, analysts, dividends,
                              options, volatility, peers, history, backtest, 10-k
aapl vs msft 5y               performance and key figures side by side
earnings this week            the earnings calendar; also dividends next week, calendar
cpi  jobs  gdp  rates         economic series and the Treasury yield curve
news  crypto  fx  world       markets
today  portfolio  settings    your home screen, holdings and setup
ask <question>                the AI analyst
A security can be a ticker (aapl, brk.b), a coin (btc) or a currency pair (eurusd).
Anything else searches for securities.

Mnemonics still work:
<security> <sector key> <function> <GO>      AAPL US <EQUITY> DES <GO>
<function> <GO>                              runs on the panel's loaded security: DES <GO>
<security> <sector key> <GO>                 loads the security and opens its function menu
<n> <GO>                                     selects numbered item n

Sector keys: GOVT  CORP  MTGE  M-MKT  MUNI  PFD  EQUITY  CMDTY  INDEX  CRNCY
A security is SYMBOL [EXCHANGE] <sector key>; equities without an exchange are US.
HELP <GO> opens this page; pick a function under "Help on" for its own page.
Text.title: Commands

cells.text: Profile of the security: business summary, key statistics, and identifiers.
Search for securities by name, ticker, or asset class.
Historical price chart with technical indicators and drawing tools.
Intraday chart of the current or a recent trading session.
Table of historical open, high, low, close, and volume.
News main menu: top stories, sources, and topics.
News for the loaded security, or general market news when none is loaded.
Financial statements and ratios: income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow.
Consensus analyst estimates for EPS, revenue, and other metrics.
Reported earnings against consensus, with surprises and price reaction.
Analyst ratings, price targets, and the consensus recommendation.
Institutional and insider holders of the security.
Dividend history and projections, and stock splits.
Upcoming earnings reports and dividend dates, for today, this week or next week.
Regulatory filings such as 10-K, 10-Q, and 8-K, with summaries and changes from the prior filing.
New regulatory filings from the companies you follow, newest first, with summaries and what changed.
Option chain with prices, implied volatility, and Greeks.
Implied volatility surface and skew across strikes and expiries.
Value options and multi-leg strategies, with payoff and scenario analysis.
Screen equities by fundamental and market criteria.
Compare the security with its peers on valuation and performance.
Performance of two or more securities rebased to 100, with price changes and key figures side by side.
Correlation of returns across a set of securities.
Backtest a trading strategy on the security's price history.
Major equity indices worldwide with price and performance.
Economic releases with actual, consensus, and prior values, plus economic data series.
Matrix of cross exchange rates between major currencies.
Home screen: how your markets and holdings are doing today and what's coming up.
Real-time worksheet of securities with configurable columns.
Most active securities ranked by volume, value traded, and price change.
Create and manage price and event alerts.
Prices and market data for cryptocurrencies.
Workspace of monitors, charts, news, and function panels across pages and displays.
Command syntax, the keyboard map, and a directory of every function; with a topic, help for one function.
Ask questions about markets and securities in plain language; numbers in answers are checked against the data used.
